meaning_gate: Every frozen fact must survive; every question must be correctly answerable. A missing fact or unsupported claim fails regardless of length. Exact protected literals and JSON types are mandatory.
readability_gate: Standalone clear sentences; identifiable referents, preserved order and conditions; no dependence on the source conversation. Compare baseline and candidate against the same questions. Explicit requests for detail override default brevity.
token_metric: Native Ollama eval_count for a non-thinking completion model, bound to the installed model digest containing its tokenizer. Record prompt_eval_count separately.
verbose_target: For each of three paired runs, compute candidate completion tokens / baseline completion tokens for the 12 verbose cases; target median <= 0.5. Report aggregate median as well.
concise_gate: Candidate output must not grow; exact preservation of the four already-concise sources is the strongest check. Compare trimmed UTF-8 bytes and words and report provider output tokens separately.
structured_case: p03 uses the same native JSON-format setting in baseline and candidate.
failed_criteria: Record failures and their bounded repair before any claimed pass; preserve all original outputs.
